title: Countercharm
html:
Countercharm is a class action available to bards at level 6. This ability allows bards to embolden their allies against charming and frightening effects.

Description

You and any allies within 9 m (30 ft) have  Advantage on  Saving Throws against being  Charmed or  Frightened.

How to learn

Classes:
  • Class level 6: Bard

Notes

  • Counter charm creates a separate entity that is immune of all damage and conditions. The player can use this to their advantage as enemy AI will sometimes target the Countercharm and waste their actions.
  • The created entity takes the form of whatever instrument is equipped by the bard. If no instruments are equipped, the Countercharm will appear as a music box.
